caption:
The AI wrapped fetch in try/catch and called it error handling. Would you merge it?

Look at the card. fetch rejects only when the request can't complete at all: no network, DNS failure, CORS block. A 404 or 500 is a complete response, so fetch resolves normally with res.ok set to false.

Here the server sends a 500 with a JSON body like { message: "..." }. res.json() parses it fine, and render() tries to draw an error object as if it were real data. catch never runs.

Check res.ok (true for status 200-299) and throw yourself when it's false. Libraries like axios reject on non-2xx statuses by default, which is why people coming from axios miss this.

Source: MDN, Using the Fetch API (checking that the fetch was successful).
